about.title: About WheelMates Wiki
about.metaDescription: Learn how WheelMates Wiki verifies sources, separates confirmed facts from unknowns, and publishes independent player guides.
about.intro: WheelMates Wiki is an independent fan resource for players exploring Firevolt’s two-player RC-car adventure.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: We organize source-checked information about co-op play, Friend’s Pass, system requirements, updates, and focused player questions.

sections.title: Editorial approach
sections.body: Official game, developer, platform, and community sources come first. We label changing information with verification dates and do not invent walkthroughs, rewards, prices, or mechanics.

sections.title: Independence
sections.body: This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Firevolt, Valve, or Steam. WheelMates names, artwork, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Review how WheelMates Wiki handles essential storage, optional analytics, advertising consent, logs, and privacy choices.
privacy.intro: WheelMates Wiki is designed to work with essential storage only; optional analytics remains off unless you allow it.

sections.title: Information we process
sections.body: The site may receive basic server logs and aggregated technical information needed for security, reliability, and abuse prevention. We do not ask for a WheelMates or Steam account.

sections.title: Analytics, advertising, and cookies
sections.body: Optional analytics storage remains disabled until consent is provided. Advertising storage is not enabled by the current site configuration; this policy will be updated before that changes.

sections.title: Your choices and changes
sections.body: You can choose essential-only use in the privacy banner. This policy will be revised when the site’s services or data practices materially change.

sections.title: Informational purpose
sections.body: Game features, prices, availability, requirements, and live values can change. Verify purchases, downloads, and account actions through the official WheelMates or Steam pages.
